instance.title: Instance
instance.subtitle: What this server resolved its configuration to. Read-only: a setting is changed in the environment, and the process restarted.

consequences.SIGNED_URLS_USE_INTERNAL_ENDPOINT: Signed URLs are issued against S3_ENDPOINT, which browsers must therefore be able to reach.
consequences.SCAN_UNLIMITED: No limit: a scan walks the whole tree it is pointed at, however large.
consequences.MARKDOWN_FALLS_BACK_TO_STIRLING: Markdown extraction falls back to Stirling's converter, which reads the text but flattens headings and tables.
consequences.VECTORIZATION_SKIPPED_NO_PROVIDER: No embeddings provider: vectorization is skipped and semantic search is unavailable. Keyword search still works.
consequences.VECTORIZATION_SKIPPED_NO_MODEL: No model to ask: vectorization is skipped.
consequences.ANALYSIS_SKIPPED_NO_PROVIDER: No provider for the analysis: the step is skipped, so no document type, place, description or title is suggested.
consequences.ANALYSIS_USES_EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER: The analysis reuses the embeddings provider.
consequences.ANALYSIS_SKIPPED_NO_MODEL: No model to ask: the analysis step is skipped.
consequences.COOKIE_NOT_SHARED_WITH_SUBDOMAINS: The session cookie is bound to the host that issued it and is not shared with subdomains.
consequences.CAPTCHA_DISABLED: CAPTCHA is disabled: login and registration accept requests without a challenge.
consequences.CAPTCHA_WIDGET_ABSENT: No CAPTCHA widget is rendered. This value is baked into the client bundle at build time, so setting it at runtime has no effect.
consequences.EMAIL_UNDELIVERABLE: No mail server is configured: letters are not sent, and the code inside one is written nowhere at all — nobody can sign up, verify an address or finish a password reset.

settings.title: How hard this instance works
settings.unitConcurrencyHint: How many independent pieces inside one job run at once — the pages of a scan set being cropped, say.
settings.analysisLanguageHint: Titles, descriptions and the names invented for people, things and kinds all use this language. Leave it empty and each follows the document it came from.

services.title: External services
services.hint: A gate per service, in front of the container or the provider itself rather than in front of a stage: Stirling renders pages for one stage and converts uploads for another, and there is one container being asked. 0 calls at once is no gate at all.
services.concurrencyHint: How many calls this service may be serving at the same time. 0 = as many as the queues ask for.
services.cooldownFor: Pause after each call to {service}, seconds
services.cooldownHint: How long to wait after one call before starting the next — after a failure as well as after a success. Waiting at a gate is time inside the job, so a service throttled to a trickle shows up as slow jobs on this page.
services.stateHint: One cheap request per service — the one it publishes for the purpose. It goes around the queues and around the gates, so it answers even while everything else is stuck.

healthHints.UNAUTHORIZED: The service is there and will not take this instance's key.
healthHints.ANSWERED: Something answered at this address, but not the way this service answers.
healthHints.DOWN: Nothing answered: refused, unresolved, or past the timeout.
healthHints.NOT_CONFIGURED: No address is configured — this instance runs without this service.

hints.stirling: Converts uploads to PDF, merges pages, renders previews and runs OCR.
hints.docling: Reads the layout of the canonical PDF into Markdown. One whole parse counts as one call.
hints.classifier: Reads a document and says what it is: type, title, description, date, people, places.
hints.transcriber: The recogniser of last resort: a vision model reading the pages OCR could not.
hints.embeddings: Turns the text into vectors for semantic search. One batch counts as one call.

hints.library-scan: Walks the attached folders and notices files that are new, changed or gone.
hints.file-ingest: Hashes each file, deduplicates it, and makes a document out of it.
hints.document-process: The five steps below: the canonical PDF, its preview, its text, the analysis, the vectors.
hints.maintenance: Hourly: expires one-time credentials, sweeps orphaned artifacts, and picks up documents nobody is coming for.

trash.title: Trash
trash.lead: Every file that has left a document and has not been destroyed yet. A file of ours is deleted once its time is up; an original on a library volume can only wait for you.
trash.goesOnVolume: Never: it lies on a read-only volume
trash.volumeNote: Deleting removes only what Legere knows about it. The file stays where it is, and Legere will not read it again.
trash.restoreNote: It does not go back into the document it came from — that document has moved on, or is gone. You get a new document holding this one file, and the pipeline reads it afresh.
trash.emptyBody: This deletes {items, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} for good — {size}. Originals on a library volume are not touched; only what Legere knows about them goes.
trash.emptied: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} deleted.
trash.unreadable: The volume no longer has these bytes
